subject.title: Ollama local provider: native tool_calls not recognized, falls back to unreliable JSON-text parsing

question: Should maintainers require an exact live Ollama request/response capture for this issue before allowing a fix PR, or should this be consolidated under the newer overlapping report?
rationale: Source already supports the obvious native `tool_calls` path, so choosing the next step depends on whether maintainers want separate proof for this reporter's `/v1`-ambiguous configuration or one canonical investigation thread.

options.title: Require exact capture first
options.body: Ask for the active provider config plus redacted OpenClaw request/response logs, optionally using the suggested ccglass-style request inspection, before any repair branch.

options.title: Consolidate with overlapping report
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101445 as the main investigation if maintainers decide the two reports share the same native Ollama extraction failure.

options.title: Keep separate until reproduced
options.body: Leave both reports open until live testing proves whether `/v1` routing, request shaping, or stream parsing is the distinguishing factor.

recommendation.title: Require exact capture first
recommendation.body: Ask for the active provider config plus redacted OpenClaw request/response logs, optionally using the suggested ccglass-style request inspection, before any repair branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main provenance touches the checked Ollama stream and diagnostic files, making this the best available routing candidate for the proof decision.
